title: The larger |value| is always at one of the two ends, so each step fills one slot from the back
caption: Squares of a sorted array: compare |nums[L]| with |nums[R]|, write the bigger square at result[write] and move that pointer inwards.

frames.text: |−4| = 4 < |10| = 10, so 10² = 100 is the largest square left. It goes in result[4] and R moves left.
Now L = 0, R = 3: 4 > 3, so (−4)² = 16 goes in result[3] and L moves right.
L = 1, R = 3: 1 < 3, so 3² = 9 goes in result[2] and R moves left.
L = 1, R = 2: 1 > 0, so (−1)² = 1 goes in result[1] and L moves right.
L = R = 2: the last one, 0² = 0, goes in result[0]. Five steps for five elements, and result is sorted.
